g.text: CARB: fist per meal, whole > white, paired (protein/fibre/fat), spread through day, breakfast
eaten; fruit whole 2/day (not juice); alcohol cautious (hypo + empty kcal — advise limits).
SALT: flavour with pepper/onion/garlic/ginger/herbs; stock cubes halved; salted fish/meats
rinsed + reduced; chop-bar "taste before salt"; bread/pastries/cheese counted; teach label
"sodium". Potassium helps BP (UNLESS kidney limits — next lesson!).
SICK-DAY + FOOT + FOLLOW: ill? NEVER stop insulin/tabs without advice — sip fluids,
eat little-often, monitor glucose, seek care early (vomiting/ketones/breathless!). Feet daily
(M01 GER screen); HbA1c + BP + lipids + weight + eyes + feet reviewed each clinic; diaries
(glucose + food + meds) reviewed WITH patient, not judged.
WEIGHT (link M05): 5–10% loss transforms diabetes/BP — portions + 150 min walk + sugary
drinks zero + sleep; refer dietician; celebrate centimetres + mmHg, not just kilos.
COUNSELLING: recall → praise → ONE change ("Coke→water", "salt-half", "evening walk") →
teach-back → cook involved (whoever seasons!) → review dated. Festivals: enjoy + plan (small
portions + dance + meds on time) — bans fail, plans stick.
FAMILY: train hypo rescue (sugar + when to rush) + foot checks + pill support; children told
simply ("Daddy's sugar — give sweets, call nurse"). Document diet + teach-back + review.
RED FLAGS: hypo unconscious/seizing · DKA signs (thirst + vomiting + deep breath + fruity) ·
foot ulcer/black toes · chest pain · BP crisis + symptoms — emergency pathways, never "diet
